description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Establish the local baseline for LegacyBlog before modernization work begins.
tasks.reason: A frozen baseline is required to compare the in-place Framework path and the .NET 10 migration path without ambiguity.
tasks.requirements: Capture current route/auth/antiforgery/validation/moderation/data-persistence behavior from LegacyBlog.sln and produce a baseline verification bundle for local execution only. Include baseline build result, key HTTP behavior checks, login checks, and restart-persistence checks. Snapshot source from LegacyBlog folder.
tasks.taskSummary: Created frozen baseline artifacts under LegacyBlog/test/test-cases, generated baseline summary, and captured passing local build/test baseline.

tasks.description: Upgrade assessment task for migration from .NET Framework 4.7.2 baseline to net10.0 target.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested comparison of in-place Framework servicing against migration to .NET 10 and ASP.NET Core MVC, with net10.0 as the configured comparison target.
tasks.requirements: Define and execute the modernization upgrade plan needed to move LegacyBlog from 4.7.2-era runtime/project assumptions to net10.0 target conditions, including project-format readiness and build pipeline compatibility. Preserve local-only execution scope and avoid cloud deployment concerns.
tasks.taskSummary: Completed .NET 4.7.2 to net10.0 readiness assessment for LegacyBlog, including project format conversion scope and local build pipeline compatibility gates. Validated baseline build and unit-test execution on current branch and produced the task modernization summary artifact.

tasks.description: Migrate HTTP pipeline and presentation behavior from System.Web/OWIN/Razor MVC5 to ASP.NET Core MVC equivalents.
tasks.reason: System.Web and OWIN startup semantics do not carry directly to .NET 10 and must be transformed with behavior parity.
tasks.requirements: Preserve all effective routes and endpoint behavior, authorization boundaries, antiforgery guarantees, validation outcomes, and moderation workflows while mapping System.Web lifecycle behavior, OWIN cookie-auth behavior, and Razor view behavior to ASP.NET Core MVC patterns. Keep local operation only.
tasks.taskSummary: Completed migration from System.Web/OWIN/MVC5 pipeline and Razor routing to ASP.NET Core MVC on .NET 10, preserving route surface, cookie-auth boundaries, antiforgery/validation behavior, and moderation workflows with passing build/tests and clean consistency validation.

tasks.description: Preserve persistent data behavior while modernizing EF6 and LocalDB usage for the target runtime path.
tasks.reason: Data continuity is required for posts, comments, moderation state, seed markers, and restart persistence.
tasks.requirements: Plan and execute data-layer modernization that retains LocalDB-backed persistence semantics and preserves existing data and moderation records. Include explicit pre-change database backup procedure, rollback procedure, and schema/data compatibility checks so the original data can be restored if acceptance checks fail.
tasks.taskSummary: Added LocalDB persistence compatibility guards, backup/restore/schema-check scripts, and startup wiring to preserve EF/LocalDB data continuity with passing build/tests.

tasks.description: Maintain authentication and original login continuity across identity modernization.
tasks.reason: Original administrator/user credentials must remain usable after migration.
tasks.requirements: Ensure ASP.NET Identity password-hash compatibility is preserved so existing logins continue to authenticate after migration. Preserve authorization behavior, cookie/session expectations, and antiforgery integration with authenticated flows while allowing secure forward compatibility for hash upgrades after successful authentication.
tasks.taskSummary: Implemented ASP.NET Identity hash-compatibility login flow by verifying with IdentityV3 (including legacy v2 support) and automatically rehashing/upgrading legacy hashes after successful authentication while preserving existing cookie auth, authorization, and antiforgery behavior. Build and tests pass.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification
tasks.reason: The user requires measurable acceptance checks for build, HTTP behavior, login compatibility, and restart persistence.
tasks.requirements: Run local post-migration verification for LegacyBlog including build success, key HTTP route/response checks, original login checks, and restart-persistence checks with persistent data retained.
tasks.taskSummary: Executed post-migration local acceptance verification end-to-end; all 21 integration checks passed covering build, HTTP behavior, login compatibility, and restart persistence. Applied required runtime/build wiring fixes to satisfy acceptance checks.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security/CVE remediation is required in every modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Assess LegacyBlog dependency set for known vulnerabilities and upgrade to patched versions where feasible while preserving baseline behavior and local execution constraints. If a fix requires a major-version jump, document compatibility risk and required follow-up validation.
tasks.taskSummary: Completed dependency CVE validation for LegacyBlog. No vulnerable NuGet packages found; no package upgrades required. Build and unit tests pass. TLS handshake issue in skill script was mitigated by dotnet CLI vulnerability audit.
